name: 10020 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10020 (New York) has 152 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 10020 (New York) has 41 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

observations.text: 46 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
